decisions.evidence: Read the full Definition and all seven supplier statements. Read all seven proof steps, facts, and 24 declared supplier interfaces. A finite affine cover makes X Noetherian and the pulled-back coordinate line bundle ample. Coherence plus eventual global generation and quasi-compactness give finitely many nonzero generators; their coefficient ideal is exactly I, not the twist treated as an ordinary ideal. The graph-closure supplier is applied only to integral finite-type X and not-all-zero meromorphic sections. Untwisting identifies the Rees algebra, and the (1,1) Segre dimension is (N+1)(n+1)-1. Integral blowups permit finite iteration; unit ideal, N=0, n=0 and zero-step composition work, while I=0 and empty X are excluded. AC inherited from the supplied Proj and coherent-twist results is stated. Stacks 31.33.9 and 31.33.13 cross-check integrality and projectivity. Refuter title finding confirmed: title is restricted to the proved integral complex scope, without changing Statement or any consumer interface. Current proof matches post-reader bytes apart from this title edit.

Read eight steps and every declared supplier interface, with Deligne III (6.2.1)-(6.2.8), printed pp.19-21. Reduced projective schemes have smooth projective covers by embedded desingularization in P^N; regular centres are proper closed subsets because they avoid the dense smooth locus, so their ideals are nonzero and the integral-projective blowup lemma applies. Chow plus reduction covers arbitrary proper schemes. Corrected step 3.1: boundary products are indexed by each injection, not one term per degree (M_1=Y_0 times_Y Y_0). Separated diagonals cut the finite matching limit out as closed in a projective product. Ordinal surjection/injection factorization defines all extension maps; identity and mixed relations follow from compatibility. Relative refinement uses base change of T_p -> M_p(T), never surjectivity of a limit inferred from termwise surjectivity. Product covers over Y and over Z give common refinement and morphism lift. Finite skeleton bookkeeping uses nonnegative bidegrees; no false coskeleton splitness remains. Empty base, constant point cover, disconnected mixed dimensions and countably many AC choices checked. Added explicit reduction dependency and synchronized contracts and manifest; no Statement change.
Pre/post item bytes agree; corrected empty boundary contract and current chain construction are sound. Risk review and manifest synchronization are audit enrichment; no mathematical defect.

Read all three proof steps and the seven supplier interfaces. Finite support implies local finiteness; conversely the cover by all locally finite neighbourhoods has a finite subcover, and every nonzero simplex has nonempty image meeting it. This includes empty X, every k>=0, zero coefficient ring and degenerate simplices. Boundary equality is literal, hence the inclusion is a chain isomorphism and its inverse induces the displayed BM-to-singular map. Continuous maps between compact Hausdorff spaces are proper because compact target subsets are closed and their inverse images are closed in compact source. The two exact topological supplier statements give these implications without AC. Reader addition accepted. The Goresky PDF was downloaded after web fetch failure; title page verifies June 26, 2026, and sections 5.3 (p.19) and 11.2 (p.34) were read. The three-step elementary proof is independently checked.

Read all six proof steps, F1-F9 and every declared supplier interface. Independently read the current MHC, strictness and descent proofs and the relevant logarithmic Godement/comparison/strictness and image/functoriality constructions. Deligne III (8.1.10)-(8.1.20), printed pp.31-35, checks the first-quadrant simplicial construction and shifted weights. Strictness follows by finite-filtration cycle correction from E1 degeneration; the rational comparison is used on cohomology, without commuting tensor with infinite Godement products. Nonnegative cosimplicial degree gives weights <= n and finite cohomology diagonals. Singular comparison checks finite affine cover, separated diagonal, deleted-boundary open stars, finite subordinate partition including scalar coordinates, compact injection into Euclidean space and the metric supplier. Common refinements identify the actual base cohomology maps. The smooth-open map is supported in cosimplicial degree zero; its first face difference vanishes, preserving pole weights and form degree. Duality uses AC for basis extension, finite dimensionality, annihilator filtrations, cup/trace type (d,d), and twist (d) giving weight -i; mixed ambient dimensions are componentwise. Removed F8 stale Hodge-type attribution to topological duality; its valid derivation remains in step 4.1 using F4. Empty, degree zero and identity class-map cases checked; all actual AC uses stated. No Statement change; current risk review complete.

Read all three steps, F1-F4, and all five actual supplier interfaces, with current proper-weight and logarithmic constructions already independently reviewed. W-strictness identifies g*(W_n source) with the entire actual image because W_n target equals target; the source W_n is exactly the compactification image, including non-SNC compactifications by the modification-image clause in the logarithmic proof. No splitting or unjustified graded-to-subspace equality is used. The lower source and upper target bounds give W_{n-1} image=0 and W_n image=image, hence pure weight n. Empty U implies empty Y and empty compactification; empty Y, n=0, U=X and reducible/nonreduced Y work. AC is inherited, with no new selection. Read Deligne II (3.2.16)-(3.2.18), pp.39-40 (smooth proper Y), Deligne III (8.2.6), p.39 with its proof (possibly singular proper Y), and the full Proposition 8.3.2 proof in de Cataldo-Migliorini arXiv v1 pp.64-65. Reader bibliographic corrections accepted; manifest synchronized to actual current sources and Statement.

Read all three verification steps and every supplier interface. The normalization P^1 and sole node with two distinct preimages are hypotheses, not inferred from arbitrary rational curves. Finite proper normalization gives the augmentation; the reduced fibre products decompose into the reduced diagonal P^1 plus isolated mixed tuples, which are open-and-closed. Reduction is functorial on reduced schemes. All compatible geometric boundary tuples lift by their unique vertices, so nilpotents in matching targets cause no surjectivity gap. Smooth projective sources are proper and matching targets separated; projective-proper and split/matching suppliers are now explicitly declared. Compressing adjacent repeats proves splitness. Directly evaluated all six mixed length-three tuples and the diagonal: delta^1 is c_d on the diagonal, aab,abb,baa,bba, and c_ab+c_ba-c_d on aba,bab. Delta^0=0; the kernel is Q(0,1,-1). H^1(P^1)=0 and E2 degeneration leave only E2^(1,0), type (0,0). Negative pieces vanish by first-quadrant q>=0; finite W then gives W_-1=0,W_0=H^1. Empty sets of mixed tuples in degree zero and AC inherited through normalization/descent/duality are checked. Reader corrections accepted; added only missing prerequisite declarations and synchronized manifest.
